title: Salesforce Einstein Recommendations pricing - Bundled GMV-based Commerce Cloud
clean_text: Einstein Recommendations is bundled with Salesforce Commerce Cloud and not priced separately. Commerce Cloud pricing is GMV-based: approximately 1–3% of GMV for B2C and 1–2% for B2B editions. Pricing is quote-driven and not publicly disclosed as a fixed schedule. Implementation and customization costs add significantly to total cost of ownership. Not viable for stores unable to justify GMV-based platform costs.
